newsitem.title: FINLAND: Boomsma new Neste oil trading head.
newsitem.headline: Boomsma new Neste oil trading head.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said in a statement on Friday that Wouter Boomsma was appointed head of its Oil Trading & Supply division from October 1.
Boomsma will be based in London. He is currently director of Neste Chemicals Trading based in Dubai, Neste said.
At the oil trading & supply division, Boomsma will replace Eija Malmivirta, who resigned earlier this month.
Neste did not say why Malmivirta resigned. But in late July, Neste said it was heading for crude oil trading losses of about 285 million markka in 1996.
Boomsma has been working for Neste since 1989, the company said.
